DyrnwynBladeFragment.desc: Parts of an old blade. If all the pieces were reassembled it could likely be made whole.

DyrnwynHiltFragment.desc: The hilt of a long forgotten sword. Perhaps it could be reforged if one had all the pieces...

DyrnwynTipFragment.desc: This shard of metal looks like the tip of a sword. One might be able to reforge the blade if more pieces are found...

Eitr.desc: This is the stuff of life, the poison that consumes itself. The Dvergr refine it to use in their esoteric designs.

ElakingHairBundle.name: Elaking Hair Bundle
ElakingHairBundle.desc: The fur is dense, coarse, and surprisingly clean.

Entrails.name: Entrails
Entrails.desc: A slimy length of something's insides.

FaderEmber.name: Embers
FaderEmber.desc: Every flying ember is a burning wish to repent.

FeastAshlands_Material.name: Ashlands Gourmet Bowl
FeastAshlands_Material.desc: It's hard to tell whether the steam coming off of this dish is because it's freshly cooked or because of the asksvin meat in it. Either way, the spiced meat together with the vineberries and fiddlehead sprouts is so delicious that it doesn't matter!

FeastBlackforest_Material.name: Black Forest Buffet Platter
FeastBlackforest_Material.desc: You won't be able to resist this platter of delights from the Black Forest! Venison sirloin steaks are served together with spiced thistles and carrots, and the whole meal is tied together with delicious jams. Just have one more bite!

FeastDeepNorth_Material.name: Northern Morning Fare
FeastDeepNorth_Material.desc: Warming and filling, this meal will sustain you even during the coldest of days. Porridge and pancakes pair well with jams and sausages, making it hard not to come back for a second helping!

FeastMeadows_Material.name: Whole Roasted Meadow Boar
FeastMeadows_Material.desc: A boar that has been roasted to perfection, glazed and served atop a bed of greens, with additional cuts of meat on the side. A feast like this is sure to fill your stomach and brighten your day!

FeastMistlands_Material.name: Mushrooms Galore á la Mistlands
FeastMistlands_Material.desc: The time has come for mushroom enthusiasts to rejoice! Try different kinds of mushrooms, mushroom marinated seeker meat and mushroom-filled misthare, and don't miss out on the tasty sap dressing.

FeastMountains_Material.name: Hearty Mountain Logger's Stew
FeastMountains_Material.desc: Gather around this steaming pot full of deliciousness and warm yourselves up again after a day out in the cold. The usually tough and chewey wolf meat has become tender enough to practically melt in your mouth, and the onions and carrots are made even tastier with exciting spices.

FeastOceans_Material.name: Sailor's Bounty
FeastOceans_Material.desc: Fish, fish, and more fish! And also serpent meat, cut to look like fish! Explore the flavours of the Ocean, along with some grilled greens for those still practicing their sea legs.

FeastPlains_Material.name: Plains Pie Picnic
FeastPlains_Material.desc: There's nothing plain about this feast! Enjoy pies and loaves fresh from the oven, both sweet and savoury, and experience the culinary equivalent of a hug.

FeastSwamps_Material.name: Swamp Dweller's Delight
FeastSwamps_Material.desc: Who knew that leeches were edible? With the correct preparation (lots of cooking and lots of seasoning) you will be able to serve them in this feast for the culinary brave. For those who have a sensitive stomach, there are also tasty skewers of sausages and turnips on the side.

FierySvinstew.name: Fiery Svinstew
FierySvinstew.desc: This musty stew is a necessity on every adventurer's menu.

FineWood.name: Finewood
FineWood.desc: High quality wood for fine carpentry.

Fish10.desc: This fish likes the water to be almost freezing cold.

Fish11.desc: Some say this fish lays its eggs directly in molten lava!

Fish12.desc: Tasty when cooked right, but the flavour has a bit of a sting.

Fish2.name: Pike
Fish2.desc: A freshwater fish that needs a lot of seasoning.

Fish4_cave.name: Tetra

Fish7.name: Grouper

SpearGoldUncooked.name: Cast: Nord Spear
SpearGoldUncooked.desc: This weapon needs to be hardened with frost.

SpearGold_BloodLightning.name: Thunderblood Spear
SpearGold_BloodLightning.desc: May it strike like lightning, quick and fierce.

SpearGold_FrostFire.name: Frostfire Spear
SpearGold_FrostFire.desc: Dipped in frozen flames, this spear spells certain doom.

SpearSplitner.name: Splitnir
SpearSplitner.desc: Split your enemies' hearts in two.

SpearSplitner_Blood.name: Splitnir the Bleeding
SpearSplitner_Blood.desc: A small sacrifice must be made for every battle...

SpearSplitner_Lightning.name: Splitnir the Storming
SpearSplitner_Lightning.desc: Let the crack of thunder split the air.

SpearSplitner_Nature.name: Splitnir the Primal
SpearSplitner_Nature.desc: Nature's forces burst through the ground wherever this spear strikes.

SpearWolfFang.name: Fang Spear
SpearWolfFang.desc: Even in death, the wolf's tooth aches for flesh.

SpiceAshlands.name: Fiery Spice Powder
SpiceAshlands.desc: Whatever spices have been used in this blend, they must come from someplace hot. And as if that wasn't enough, they have also been dried and smoked before being ground into a fine powder.

SpiceDeepNorth.name: Seasoning of the Gourd
SpiceDeepNorth.desc: Using cinnamon bark and ginger root, with a touch of nutmeg, the herbalist has travelled far to create this fine and warming blend of spices.

SpiceForests.name: Woodland Herb Blend
SpiceForests.desc: Thyme and marjoram carefully harvested and dried, before being mixed together. This blend will turn even the most basic of ingredients into a delicious feast.

SpiceMistlands.name: Herbs of the Hidden Hills
SpiceMistlands.desc: A good herbalist knows exactly where to go to find ramsons, but she won't tell you the secrets of her trade! Still, if you have the coin for it you may treat yourself to this blend of finely harvested ramson bulbs and leaves.

SpiceMountains.name: Mountain Peak Pepper Powder
SpiceMountains.desc: Only the most seasoned herbalist can find the pepperwood tree and harvest its leaves and bark. After careful preparation it's ready to be added to food, and is sure to give it some warming heat.

SpiceOceans.name: Seafarer's Herbs
SpiceOceans.desc: The sour tang of sorrel, mixed with something the herbalist would rather not disclose, is well suitable for fish. Any fisherfolk worth their salt would do well to keep this blend near, in case of a good catch!

SpicePlains.name: Grasslands Herbalist Harvest
SpicePlains.desc: This blend utilises all aspects of the lovage plant, a rarity in the tenth world. Roots, leaves and seeds have all been gathered, and then mixed together in the perfect quantity.

SpicyMarmalade.name: Spicy Marmalade
SpicyMarmalade.desc: Sugary honey perfectly balanced with tangy fronds and tart berries.

StaffClusterbomb.name: Staff of Fracturing
StaffClusterbomb.desc: Only those with patience and focus will be able to harness the true power of this staff.

StaffFireball.name: Staff of Embers
StaffFireball.desc: The sweltering heat of Muspelheim seems almost pathetic when compared to what this staff can do...

StaffFrostOrbs.name: Northern Vengeance
StaffFrostOrbs.desc: A caged snowflake, endless patterns emerging from within...

StaffFrostOrbsUncooked.name: Cast: Northern Vengeance
StaffFrostOrbsUncooked.desc: This magical item needs to be hardened with frost.

StaffGreenRoots.name: Staff of the Wild
StaffGreenRoots.desc: Ancient natural forces lie curled and dormant within this staff, ready to be unleashed.

StaffIceShards.name: Staff of Frost
StaffIceShards.desc: A staff as cold as the three-year winter that will herald the end of times.

StaffLightning.name: Dundr
StaffLightning.desc: What happens next may shock you.

StaffOrbofAhri.name: Echo Spike
StaffOrbofAhri.desc: A chill that goes right through to the bone.

StaffOrbofAhriUncooked.name: Cast: Echo Spike
StaffOrbofAhriUncooked.desc: This magical item needs to be hardened with frost.

StaffRedTroll.name: Trollstav
StaffRedTroll.desc: Summons a raging beast to cause death and destruction.

StaffShield.name: Staff of Protection
StaffShield.desc: For a slight blood offering it will protect the caster in a magical shell.

StaffSkeleton.name: Dead Raiser
StaffSkeleton.desc: Sacrifice a bit of blood to raise the dead. Upgrade the skull to spawn multiple skeletons, and increase your blood magic to make them stronger.

StaffSpiritCaller.name: Spirit Caller
StaffSpiritCaller.desc: Summon otherworldly aid. It only costs a drop of your blood...

StaffSpiritCallerUncooked.name: Cast: Spirit Caller
StaffSpiritCallerUncooked.desc: This magical item needs to be hardened with frost.

StaffThunderBlood.name: Lightning Strike
StaffThunderBlood.desc: Simply point, and you shall summon the wrath of the sky.

StaffThunderbloodUncooked.name: Cast: Lightning Strike
StaffThunderbloodUncooked.desc: This magical item needs to be hardened with frost.

SwordBlackmetal.name: Black Metal Sword
SwordBlackmetal.desc: A thing of death and beauty. It catches the light with a greenish glow.

SwordDyrnwyn.name: Dyrnwyn
SwordDyrnwyn.desc: The sword that was broken is whole once more. Its flames burn hot, fuelled by the memories of ancient warriors.

SwordGold.name: Nord Sword
SwordGold.desc: Even in the faintest sunlight, this weapon glimmers.

SwordGoldUncooked.name: Cast: Nord Sword
SwordGoldUncooked.desc: This weapon needs to be hardened with frost.

SwordGold_BloodLightning.name: Thunderblood Sword
SwordGold_BloodLightning.desc: As the blood runs along the blade, it awakens the storm within.

SwordGold_FrostFire.name: Frostfire Sword
SwordGold_FrostFire.desc: Flames dance along this blade, but are they hot or cold?

SwordIron.name: Iron Sword
SwordIron.desc: The straight line between life and death runs along the edge of this blade.

SwordMistwalker.name: Mistwalker
SwordMistwalker.desc: The faint glow seems to slice through the mist.

SwordNiedhogg.name: Nidhögg
SwordNiedhogg.desc: Named after the evil dragon that dwells by the roots of the world tree, this sword heralds doom for those who cross its path.

SwordNiedhoggBlood.name: Nidhögg the Bleeding
SwordNiedhoggBlood.desc: If you bleed, your foes are sure to do so as well.

SwordNiedhoggLightning.name: Nidhögg the Thundering
SwordNiedhoggLightning.desc: The power of lightning dances along the blade of this sword, a promise of the pain to come.

SwordNiedhoggNature.name: Nidhögg the Primal
SwordNiedhoggNature.desc: Tangle your foes in roots, like the namesake of this blade.

SwordSilver.name: Silver Sword
SwordSilver.desc: Purest of metals, nothing unclean can abide its touch.

SwordWood.name: Wooden Sword
SwordWood.desc: Mostly harmless, unless you're very persistent.

THSwordGold.name: Nord Greatsword
THSwordGold.desc: A striking weapon, both visually and lethally.

THSwordGoldUncooked.name: Cast: Nord Greatsword
THSwordGoldUncooked.desc: This weapon needs to be hardened with frost.

THSwordGold_BloodLightning.name: Thunderblood Greatsword
THSwordGold_BloodLightning.desc: Anyone wielding this weapon is sure to be very frightening indeed.

THSwordGold_FrostFire.name: Frostfire Greatsword
THSwordGold_FrostFire.desc: The choice between a fiery end and a frozen one is simple: Both at the same time.

THSwordKrom.name: Krom
THSwordKrom.desc: As deadly as it is shiny, and it's very shiny.

THSwordSlayer.name: Slayer
THSwordSlayer.desc: This mighty blade thirsts for the blood of foes.

THSwordSlayerBlood.name: Brutal Slayer
THSwordSlayerBlood.desc: If it bleeds, you can kill it.

THSwordSlayerLightning.name: Scourging Slayer
THSwordSlayerLightning.desc: The lightning bound into this blade is erratic, ever searching for something to strike.

THSwordSlayerNature.name: Primal Slayer
THSwordSlayerNature.desc: The blade works in tandem with the primal forces of the world, seeking death and slaughter.

TankardAnniversary.name: Horn of Celebration
TankardAnniversary.desc: One year since we arrived... Skål!

TankardOdin.name: Mead Horn of Oden
TankardOdin.desc: Oden's finest warriors deserve the finest drinks.

Tin.name: Tin
Tin.desc: A bar of pure tin ready to be worked.

Torch.name: Torch
Torch.desc: It brings light and warmth, drives back the darkness.

TrinketBlackDamageHealth.name: Bracelets of the Brave
TrinketBlackDamageHealth.desc: Your mind hardens, as do your blows.

TrinketBlackStamina.name: Evasion Mantle
TrinketBlackStamina.desc: Dance with death as you dodge your enemies' strikes.

TrinketBloodGoldHealth.name: Neckstabber
TrinketBloodGoldHealth.desc: Claw and bone and gold – grant them blood and they shall grant you a boon.

TrinketBloodGoldStamina.name: Witch Crown
TrinketBloodGoldStamina.desc: They say that the soul of a witch can grant strange powers to mortals...

TrinketBronzeHealth.name: Heart of the Forest
TrinketBronzeHealth.desc: It pulsates with fragments of ancient life.

TrinketBronzeStamina.name: Bronze Pendant
TrinketBronzeStamina.desc: A beautiful pendant, harbouring the endurance of a bear.

TrinketCarapaceEitr.name: Pulsating Earrings
TrinketCarapaceEitr.desc: If you listen carefully, you can hear the faint echoes of lost souls...

TrinketChitinSwim.name: Fins of Destiny
TrinketChitinSwim.desc: Empty your mind as you become shapeless and one with the water.

TrinketFlametalStaminaHealth.name: Brimstone
TrinketFlametalStaminaHealth.desc: It's warm, as if filled with a lifesblood of its own.

TrinketIronStamina.name: Nimble Anklet
TrinketIronStamina.desc: Puts a spring in your step!

TrinketScaleStaminaDamage.name: Resounding Shackle
TrinketScaleStaminaDamage.desc: A razor-sharp ankle chain. Can it truly be comfortable?

TrinketSilverDamage.name: Wolf Sight
TrinketSilverDamage.desc: Assume the sharp and furious mind of a wolf.

TrinketSilverResist.name: Crystal Heart
TrinketSilverResist.desc: A shard of frozen sorrow. Touching it makes you feel almost numb.

TrollHide.name: Troll Hide
TrollHide.desc: A thick and sturdy hide. This is why trolls are so hard to kill.

TrophyAbomination.name: Abomination Trophy
TrophyAbomination.desc: A tangled mess of roots and bark.

TrophyBjornUndead.name: Vile Trophy
TrophyBjornUndead.desc: These eyes are finally vacant for good.

TrophyBlob.name: Blob Trophy
TrophyBlob.desc: A smelly lump of sticky matter.

TrophyBlob_Morkhalla.name: Pulp Trophy
TrophyBlob_Morkhalla.desc: Remains of unfortunate adventurers, digested and jellified over time.

TrophyCharredMelee.name: Warrior Trophy
TrophyCharredMelee.desc: Fractures line this skull, as if it has taken many hits over the years.

TrophyCultist.name: Cultist Trophy
TrophyCultist.desc: My, what big teeth it has...

TrophyDeer.name: Deer Trophy
TrophyDeer.desc: A fine specimen, but you'll need to kill more than deer to enter Valhalla.

TrophyDraugrElite.name: Draugr Elite Trophy
TrophyDraugrElite.desc: The dead stare of the glowing red eyes sends a shiver through your bones.

TrophyFallenValkyrie.name: Fallen Valkyrie Trophy
TrophyFallenValkyrie.desc: Though she is dead, she yearns for the blood to flow.

TrophyFenring.name: Fenring Trophy
TrophyFenring.desc: A strange, elongated paw, its claws razor sharp.

TrophyFrostTroll.name: Troll Trophy
TrophyFrostTroll.desc: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.

TrophyGoblin.name: Fuling Trophy
TrophyGoblin.desc: Loose folds of greenish skin gathered in around a pair of dark and hateful eyes.

TrophyGoblinBrute.name: Fuling Berserker Trophy
TrophyGoblinBrute.desc: The huge grizzled head is as heavy as a boulder.

TrophyGreydwarfShaman.name: Greydwarf Shaman Trophy
TrophyGreydwarfShaman.desc: It may try to come back so be sure to prune any new shoots...

TrophyJotunWitch.name: Hexen Trophy
TrophyJotunWitch.desc: Before her death, her eyes sparked with magic. Now they're empty and void.

TrophyLeech.name: Leech Trophy
TrophyLeech.desc: Although slimy, the skin is beautifully patterned in red and black.

TrophyLox.name: Lox Trophy
TrophyLox.desc: A giant beast's head, thatched with thick fur.

TrophyMoose.name: Moose Trophy
TrophyMoose.desc: The mighty ruler of the northern forests.

TrophyMorgen.name: Morgen Trophy
TrophyMorgen.desc: The waking nightmare has met its end.

TrophySGolem.name: Stone Golem Trophy
TrophySGolem.desc: This crystalline rock formation would make for an impressive floor decoration.

TrophySeeker.name: Seeker Trophy
TrophySeeker.desc: Less delicate than they look. The leather of the wings catches the firelight as if remembering flight.

TrophySerpent.name: Serpent Trophy
TrophySerpent.desc: The scales have dulled but the eyes are still bright.

TrophySkeleton.name: Skeleton Trophy
TrophySkeleton.desc: The expressionless grin of this skull reminds you of the inevitability of death.

TrophySurtling.name: Surtling Trophy
TrophySurtling.desc: Wreathed in pale flame, it still smoulders like an ember.

TrophyWolf.name: Wolf Trophy
TrophyWolf.desc: Frozen in death, the hair matted with blood and a silent howl lodged in its throat.

Turnip.name: Turnip
Turnip.desc: A dense vegetable, rich with nutrition.

TurretBolt.name: Black Metal Missile
TurretBolt.desc: These thick missiles can punch through the hide of even the toughest foes.

TurretBoltBloodgold.name: Bloodgold Missile
TurretBoltBloodgold.desc: Your attacker shall stand no chance as this missile finds its target.

TurretBoltFlametal.name: Flametal Missile
TurretBoltFlametal.desc: Forged from one of the hardest metals in all of Valheim, this missile is sure to hold off your enemies.

TurretBoltWood.name: Wooden Missile
TurretBoltWood.desc: Sturdy wooden missiles that can provide a tough defense against foes.

UndeadBjornRibcage.name: Vile Ribcage
UndeadBjornRibcage.desc: A relic of savage strength, perfect for forging armour that bears the wild’s fury.

VoltureMeat.desc: Given that this bird feasts on all kinds of things, you'd better cook its meat before you even think about eating it.
